{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for SEVERE disease
severe_df = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check how many patients (not rows) have SEVERE disease
print("Number of rows with SEVERE disease:", len(severe_df))
print("Number of unique patients with SEVERE disease:", severe_df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for duplicate patient_ids in SEVERE group
duplicate_patients = severe_df[severe_df.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]
print("Number of duplicate patient_ids in SEVERE group:", len(duplicate_patients))

# Check if any of these duplicates have sample_seq > 1
retested_severe = duplicate_patients[duplicate_patients['sample_seq'] > 1]
print("Number of retested patients (sample_seq > 1) in SEVERE group:", len(retested_severe))

# Check if any SEVERE patients have -999 in baseline
bad_baseline_severe = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print("Number of SEVERE patients with -999 baseline:", len(bad_baseline_severe))"}
